import pandas as pd

# Load all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column

# Source 0: Source9_24_0
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_0.csv"
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Source 1: Source9_24_1
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_1.csv"
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Source 3: Source9_24_3
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_3.csv"
df3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)

# Source 4: Source9_24_4
source4_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_4.csv"
df4 = pd.read_csv(source4_path, index_col=0)

# Source 6: Source9_24_6
source6_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_6.csv"
df6 = pd.read_csv(source6_path, index_col=0)

# Source 8: Source9_24_8
source8_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_8.csv"
df8 = pd.read_csv(source8_path, index_col=0)

# Source 9: Source9_24_9
source9_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_9.csv"
df9 = pd.read_csv(source9_path, index_col=0)

# Source 7: Source9_24_7
source7_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_7.csv"
df7 = pd.read_csv(source7_path, index_col=0)

# According to the operation history, we join in this order:
# 1) df0 JOIN df1 on ROW_WID
# 2) result JOIN df3 on ROW_WID
# 3) result JOIN df4 on ROW_WID
# 4) result JOIN df6 on ROW_WID
# 5) result JOIN df8 on ROW_WID
# 6) result JOIN df9 on ROW_WID
# 7) result JOIN df7 on ROW_WID

# We will do left joins starting from df0 to keep all rows from df0 (which has the largest base schema)

# Join df0 and df1
df = pd.merge(df0, df1, how='left', left_on='ROW_WID', right_on='ROW_WID')

# Join with df3
df = pd.merge(df, df3, how='left', left_on='ROW_WID', right_on='ROW_WID')

# Join with df4
df = pd.merge(df, df4, how='left', left_on='ROW_WID', right_on='ROW_WID')

# Join with df6
df = pd.merge(df, df6, how='left', left_on='ROW_WID', right_on='ROW_WID', suffixes=('', '_df6'))

# Because df6 has columns that overlap with df0 (same schema except suffix), 
# we need to resolve duplicates by preferring df0 columns (from original df0) 
# and filling missing values from df6 columns.

# List of columns from df0 (original) that are duplicated in df6 (with _df6 suffix)
overlap_cols = ['CANCELED', 'ACCNT_LOC', 'ARPU', 'SES', 'HOME_PASSED', 'CUST_SINCE_DT', 'MONTHS_AGE', 'CANCEL_DT', 'CITY', 'POP']

for col in overlap_cols:
    col_df6 = col + '_df6'
    if col_df6 in df.columns:
        # Fill missing values in original col with values from df6
        df[col] = df[col].combine_first(df[col_df6])
        # Drop the df6 suffixed column
        df.drop(columns=[col_df6], inplace=True)

# Join with df8
df = pd.merge(df, df8, how='left', left_on='ROW_WID', right_on='ROW_WID')

# Join with df9
df = pd.merge(df, df9, how='left', left_on='ROW_WID', right_on='ROW_WID')

# Join with df7
# df7 has the same schema as df0, so suffixes needed to avoid column conflicts
df = pd.merge(df, df7, how='left', left_on='ROW_WID', right_on='ROW_WID', suffixes=('', '_df7'))

# Resolve duplicates between df0 columns and df7 columns (with _df7 suffix)
for col in overlap_cols:
    col_df7 = col + '_df7'
    if col_df7 in df.columns:
        # Fill missing values in original col with values from df7
        df[col] = df[col].combine_first(df[col_df7])
        # Drop the df7 suffixed column
        df.drop(columns=[col_df7], inplace=True)

# Now, ensure the final dataframe has exactly the target schema columns in the correct order:
target_columns = [
    'CANCELED', 'ROW_WID', 'ACCNT_LOC', 'ARPU', 'SES', 'HOME_PASSED',
    'CUST_SINCE_DT', 'MONTHS_AGE', 'CANCEL_DT', 'CITY', 'POP',
    'COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM', 'INBOUND_CALLS_NUM', 'KEYWORDS_NUM',
    'VISITS_NUM', 'TECHSUPPORT_NUM', 'INTERACTIONS_NUM'
]

# Some columns come from joined tables:
# COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM from df4
# INBOUND_CALLS_NUM from df8
# KEYWORDS_NUM from df1
# VISITS_NUM from df3
# TECHSUPPORT_NUM from df5 (not joined, so we need to load and join it)
# INTERACTIONS_NUM from df9

# We missed df5 (Source9_24_5) in the joins, so load and join it now:

source5_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_5.csv"
df5 = pd.read_csv(source5_path, index_col=0)

df = pd.merge(df, df5, how='left', left_on='ROW_WID', right_on='ROW_WID')

# Now TECHSUPPORT_NUM is included from df5

# After all joins, select and reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_final = df[target_columns]

# Data type corrections to match target schema:

# CANCELED: integer
df_final['CANCELED'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['CANCELED'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# ROW_WID: integer
df_final['ROW_WID'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['ROW_WID'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# ACCNT_LOC: integer
df_final['ACCNT_LOC'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['ACCNT_LOC'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# ARPU: float
df_final['ARPU'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['ARPU'], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0).astype(float)

# SES: string (fill missing with empty string)
df_final['SES'] = df_final['SES'].fillna('').astype(str)

# HOME_PASSED: integer
df_final['HOME_PASSED'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['HOME_PASSED'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# CUST_SINCE_DT: string (fill missing with empty string)
df_final['CUST_SINCE_DT'] = df_final['CUST_SINCE_DT'].fillna('').astype(str)

# MONTHS_AGE: float
df_final['MONTHS_AGE'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['MONTHS_AGE'], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0).astype(float)

# CANCEL_DT: string (fill missing with empty string)
df_final['CANCEL_DT'] = df_final['CANCEL_DT'].fillna('').astype(str)

# CITY: string (fill missing with empty string)
df_final['CITY'] = df_final['CITY'].fillna('').astype(str)

# POP: string (fill missing with empty string)
df_final['POP'] = df_final['POP'].fillna('').astype(str)

# COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM: integer
df_final['COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# INBOUND_CALLS_NUM: integer
df_final['INBOUND_CALLS_NUM'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['INBOUND_CALLS_NUM'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# KEYWORDS_NUM: integer
df_final['KEYWORDS_NUM'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['KEYWORDS_NUM'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# VISITS_NUM: integer
df_final['VISITS_NUM'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['VISITS_NUM'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# TECHSUPPORT_NUM: integer
df_final['TECHSUPPORT_NUM'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['TECHSUPPORT_NUM'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# INTERACTIONS_NUM: integer
df_final['INTERACTIONS_NUM'] = pd.to_numeric(df_final['INTERACTIONS_NUM'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Export the final dataframe to CSV
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/target_multisource.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

source9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_24/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all dimension tables with the same schema (Source0, Source2, Source6, Source7)
# They share the same schema and correspond to the dimension part of the target
union_dim = pd.concat([source0, source2, source6, source7], ignore_index=True)

# Join union_dim with all aspect tables on ROW_WID
# Aspect tables: source1(KEYWORDS_NUM), source3(VISITS_NUM), source4(COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM),
# source5(TECHSUPPORT_NUM), source8(INBOUND_CALLS_NUM), source9(INTERACTIONS_NUM)

# Start joining step by step
df = union_dim.merge(source1, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = df.merge(source3, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = df.merge(source4, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = df.merge(source5, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = df.merge(source8, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = df.merge(source9, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Group by leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema:
# Target schema leftmost columns: 
# ['CANCELED'(int), 'ROW_WID'(int), 'ACCNT_LOC'(int), 'ARPU'(float), 'SES'(str), 'HOME_PASSED'(int), 'CUST_SINCE_DT'(str), 'MONTHS_AGE'(float), 'CANCEL_DT'(str), 'CITY'(str), 'POP'(str), ...]

    "CANCELED",

    "ACCNT_LOC",
    "SES",
    "HOME_PASSED",
    "CUST_SINCE_DT",
    "CANCEL_DT",
    "CITY",
    "POP",
]

    "ARPU": "max",
